result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position by providing a professional-and-workmanlike services warranty, a 12-month material-conformance warranty for the Licensed Technology, repair/re-performance/replacement/refund remedies, compliance with applicable laws, and a no-malicious-code warranty, all expressly carved out from the disclaimer. It preserves the remaining disclaimer and unrelated commercial allocation. It is not strictly minimal because the services warranty has no 90-day limit and the conformance warranty also covers Specifications and adds an industry-standards requirement, modestly exceeding the stated position. Drafting is generally professional, although it depends on “Acceptance Date,” “Documentation,” and “Specifications” being defined.
